title: Vexy Stax Scene
description: Shared scene format v1 for vexy-stax-py and vexy-stax-js. See SPEC.md.

gap.description: Points between adjacent plates in expanded view. A value of 0 is resolved to MIN_GAP (3.0).

distance.description: Camera distance: absolute points as a number/string, or viewport-fit percentage like "100%".

elevation.description: Degrees above horizon for expanded view.

wait.description: Hold seconds at the far end.

video.description: Video render params (issue 335 §3): dimensions/fps/frame counts/held stills. transition still owns the animation (kind/easing/wait/duration); video owns the output framing. Defaults preserve prior behavior.

fps.description: Video frames per second; omitted ⇒ transition.fps (else 30). Overrides transition.fps when set.

frames.description: Transition frames PER LEG; omitted ⇒ round(transition.duration × fps).

first_hold.description: Held copies of the FIRST frame (still intro).

last_hold.description: Held copies of the LAST frame (still outro).

opacity.description: 0 = no visible floor pane; raise for a visible floor (issue 342 follow-up).

width.description: Border thickness as a fraction of plate height; 0 = off (issue 326: slide + caption borders off by default).

color.description: Slide-plate border color; also the default caption plate fill + border (issue 324).

captions.description: Global captions toggle (issue 332). ON: each slide plate sits on top of its on-floor caption plate (stacked layout). OFF: no caption plates; slide plates sit directly on the floor.

caption_fade.description: Caption fade-in timing during a transition (issue 302 §B.4 / 309).

window.description: Fraction of the morph (from the end) over which captions fade in.

stagger.description: Back→front succession spread as a fraction of the fade window.

stagger_frames.description: Issue 309: back→front per-caption step in transition frames; overrides stagger when set.

slides.description: Ordered back-to-front: index 0 is farthest from the camera.

src.description: Path relative to the scene file, or a data: URI.

gap.description: Per-slide gap override (points). Omit the key to inherit camera.gap; null or 0 collapses to the minimal gap (MIN_GAP, 3.0).

opacity.description: Constant scalar, or per-view values interpolated during transitions.

size.description: Font size for the caption text (1em) in scene-point units.

color.description: Color for the caption text (e.g., hex string like '#222222').

font.description: Font family name (e.g., 'sans-serif', 'Arial') or a path to a TrueType/OpenType font file.

fill_color.description: Caption plate FILL color (issue 324); defaults to scene.edge.color when omitted.

border_color.description: Caption plate BORDER color (issue 324); defaults to scene.edge.color when omitted.
